# Nod

> Nod is a Stellar wallet that lives inside the AI you already use. Apps are turning into conversations and agents, so the wallet sits in the chat: one connector URL in Claude, Goblin, Claude Code or any MCP app, and in ChatGPT as a developer-mode connector. You sign up with a passkey and hold USDC; you never meet XLM, a seed phrase or a trustline. You give each AI app one allowance, say 5 USDC until tomorrow. Inside it, the app pays for APIs over x402 and pays people on its own. Anything past it needs your passkey, every time, for any amount. The allowance is an OpenZeppelin spending-limit policy on your own Stellar account, so the most Nod's service could ever spend for an AI app is the allowance you set, pocket included. Small stuff, it just pays. Big stuff needs your nod.

Built at HackMeridian 2026 (Lisbon, 25–26 October 2026), Genesis builder track, Stellar Composed thematic track. The full flow runs on Stellar mainnet at trynod.si, in claude.ai, on the founder's own wallet: an x402 purchase settled by OpenZeppelin Channels, a payment inside the allowance, one that needed the nod, a claim link that created a trustline and paid in one transaction, a revoke that removed the rule and swept the pocket.

## Hosts

- https://trynod.si/ is the product on Stellar mainnet. Signup is open; the wallet holds USDC only. MCP connector: https://trynod.si/mcp
- https://testnet.trynod.si/ is the judges' sandbox on Stellar testnet. New wallets get 10 testnet USDC; no real money moves. MCP connector: https://testnet.trynod.si/mcp
- https://testnet.trynod.si/sample runs a sample agent through the same tools on Nod's own demo wallet, with a live log and explorer links. No Claude needed.
- The old host hack-meridian-testnet.kristjan-grm11775.workers.dev redirects to testnet.trynod.si.

## Try it on the sandbox

- In Claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, URL https://testnet.trynod.si/mcp. In Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http -s user nod https://testnet.trynod.si/mcp`.
- On the page that opens, create a passkey wallet and set Claude's allowance: 5 USDC until tomorrow 12:00 UTC.
- Ask Claude "Buy the market brief" (0.10 USDC over x402, no prompt; 4.90 left), "Send Alice 2 USDC" (paid on its own; 2.90 left), "Pay Bob 5 USDC for dinner" (more than what is left, so it needs your nod: open the link and approve with your passkey; the allowance stays 2.90), the same request again (the same receipt; Bob is paid once), "Send Alice 4 USDC" (needs your nod), "Send Carol 1 USDC" (Carol has never held USDC: after your nod she gets a claim link, and her trustline and the payment land in one transaction). Then revoke Claude under Connections.
- Full judge test path with expected results: https://github.com/grmkris/hack-meridian-2026/blob/main/evidence/JUDGE-TEST-PATH.md

## How it works

- Passkey wallet: Face ID or a fingerprint creates an OpenZeppelin smart account (a Stellar contract account). Nod's relayer accounts are the transaction source and pay every network fee, so the owner holds no XLM.
- One allowance per AI app: connecting an app over OAuth 2.1 and setting its allowance with the passkey is one step. Each allowance is a context rule on the account: the app's own Ed25519 key, OpenZeppelin's spending-limit policy (the total the app may spend on its own) and an expiry.
- Past the allowance: the payment is never signed with the app's key. It becomes a link showing the recipient's name and address, the amount and which app asked; the passkey signs that payment on Nod's own page, never in the chat, whatever the amount. Approved payments do not use the allowance.
- Cards and notifications: Nod serves MCP Apps cards (ui://nod/card/v1, ui://nod/home/v1) and MCP Events (payment.received, payment.settled, approval.needed, allowance.changed, request.received, request.answered) by webhook or poll, on the 2025 MCP protocol and on 2026-07-28, where the nod is a native URL request. Cards and the nod are shown live in Goblin, claude.ai and ChatGPT (developer-mode connector; not listed in ChatGPT's app store, whose policy bars crypto transfers). Events arrive in Goblin and ChatGPT; claude.ai and Claude Code do not implement MCP Events, so there the cards poll.
- Paid APIs: x402 sellers are paid through public facilitators (x402.org, OpenZeppelin Channels), never one Nod runs. Hosted facilitators do not take smart-account payers yet, so each AI app's key also owns a small pocket account with sponsored reserves, filled from the wallet under the same policy in 1 USDC steps, which pays with the stock x402 client. Both transactions are on the receipt. Ask twice, pay once.
- Claim link: a recipient with no USDC trustline gets a link. The sender nods once; the recipient accepts with Freighter within 30 minutes (their account needs about 0.5 XLM for the trustline reserve), and a small router calls the USDC contract's trust function (CAP-73) and the transfer in one transaction.
- Revoke: Nod stops signing at once and sweeps the pocket back; one passkey tap removes the allowance from the account.
- Deposit addresses (testnet only): a sponsored G… account bound to one wallet by Nod's deposit router; anyone can sweep what arrives, and it can only go to that wallet. Off on mainnet.
